description:
Activate Twilight Drover by paying {2}{W} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens with flying and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing the Soldier and Spirits, adding {2}{W}.
When the Spirits and Soldier die, Twilight Drover triggers three times, putting three +1/+1 counters on itself.
Repeat.
